product.description:
Features:

  • The innovative 3D MultiFlex cutlery tray features an adjustable design that creates dedicated space for utensils, small cups, and kitchen tools while maximizing interior capacity.
  • ExtraComfort baskets provide flexible loading with adjustable racks and specialized holders designed to securely accommodate delicate stemware, plates, and large cookware.
  • Miele ComfortClose technology allows the dishwasher door to open and close smoothly while remaining securely positioned at any angle for effortless everyday use.
  • An integrated water softener helps reduce mineral buildup and protects dishes and glassware from spots and film in hard water conditions.
  • Experience ultra-quiet operation at just 42 dB, ensuring your dishwasher runs silently without disturbing your home environment.
  • Enjoy peace of mind with a comprehensive two year manufacturer warranty covering both parts and labor for reliable protection.

Product Technology:

AutoOpen Drying: Flawlessly dry dishes. The door opens automatically at the end of a cycle, letting warm air escape for perfectly dry items—even plastics—while protecting your countertops from moisture.

QuickIntenseWash Cycle: Delivers outstanding cleaning performance for normally soiled dishes in just 58 minutes — fast, efficient, and thorough.

Energy Efficiency: Exceptionally energy-efficient while delivering outstanding cleaning and drying performance.

Half Load: Smart load sensing technology automatically adjusts water usage based on the amount of dishware — saving water and energy with every cycle.

Specifications:

  • Place Setting Capacity: 16
  • Number of Cycles: 4
  • Number of Racks: 3
  • Display Type: Digital
  • Control Type: Touch
  • Cutlery Tray: Yes
  • Sanitary Rinse: Yes
  • Spray Arms: 3
  • dB Rating: 42
  • Depth: 22-1/2"
  • Height: 33-3/4"
  • Width: 24"
  • Amperage: 15A
  • Voltage: 110, 120V
